meta.title: Screenshot Demo Blueprint
meta.description: A demonstration blueprint showing how automatic screenshots work
meta.author: WordPress

steps.command: wp option update blogname 'Screenshot Demo Site'
wp option update blogdescription 'Automatically generated screenshots showcase this blueprint'

wp post create --post_title='Welcome to Screenshot Generation' --post_content='

This blueprint demonstrates the automatic screenshot generation feature. When you submit a blueprint via PR, screenshots are automatically captured and added to your branch!

The gallery then displays these screenshots to help users visualize what your blueprint creates.

' --post_status='publish'
